task: Review every supplied part, discover the most consequential events from the supplied evidence, cluster related reports, assign the best-fit broad news category dynamically and produce up to 150 processed stories using schema/processed-news.schema.json. items.title: A Fundamental Right
items.summary: With its new law that makes education a fundamental right with effect from April 1, 2010, India joins a small group of countries with such a statutory provision. All children in the 6 to 14 age group can exercise the right under the Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education Act, 2009. An estimated one crore children who do not go to school now are expected to benefit.
